title: The Typewriter of the Lower Danube
author: O. M. Vane
blurb: Astrid Dravenmoor, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
